name: Yotpo
label: Yotpo Reviews v1 + Core v3 (Loyalty is a second host)
description: Reviews/UGC on api.yotpo.com. Official review list wants query utoken (OAuth from POST /oauth/token minted outside StudioQuack). This node sends config utoken as query utoken. loyalty_adjust calls the Loyalty host https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/points/adjust with headers X-GUID / X-API-KEY from config loyalty_guid / loyalty_api_key. Moderate UGC before republish. Docs: https://apidocs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-all-reviews
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: review_list | review_create | order_send | loyalty_adjust | trigger. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: page
schema.description: review_list page (1-based). Example: 1. Max 100 reviews per page via count.

schema.label: count
schema.description: review_list page size. Default 10, max 100. Example: 25.

schema.label: since_id
schema.description: review_list: return reviews after this review id. Example: 123456789.

schema.label: app_key
schema.description: Yotpo store id (appkey). review_create body field appkey (config app_key is the fallback). Also the path {app_key} on review_list and order_send. Example: your store id.

schema.label: sku
schema.description: Product id for review_create. Alphanumeric plus _ and -. Use yotpo_site_reviews for a site review. Required. Example: PHONE-1.

schema.label: product_title
schema.description: Product title for review_create. Required by Yotpo widget docs. Example: Phone.

schema.label: product_url
schema.description: Product URL for review_create. Required by Yotpo widget docs. Example: https://shop.example/phone.

schema.label: product_description
schema.description: Optional product description for review_create.

schema.label: product_image_url
schema.description: Optional product image URL for review_create.

schema.label: display_name
schema.description: Reviewer display name for review_create. Required unless a reviewer token is used. Example: John Smith.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Reviewer email for review_create. Required unless a reviewer token is used. PII — do not log. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: review_title
schema.description: Review title for review_create. Example: Great Phone.

schema.label: review_content
schema.description: Review body for review_create. Required. Example: It's really good.

schema.label: review_score
schema.description: Star score 1-5 for review_create. Required. Example: 5.

schema.label: domain
schema.description: Account domain for review_create. Example: shop.example.

schema.label: is_incentivized
schema.description: review_create. true when the review came from a sample, coupon, or loyalty reward.

schema.label: incentive_type
schema.description: review_create when is_incentivized. EXACT: free_product | coupon | loyalty_points | paid_promotion | employee_review | other.

schema.label: orders
schema.description: Core v3 order array for order_send POST /core/v3/stores/{app_key}/orders. Each item: {order_id, order_date, customer:{email,first_name,last_name}, line_items:[{sku,name,quantity}]}. https://apidocs.yotpo.com/

schema.label: customer_email
schema.description: Loyalty points adjust: customer email. PII — do not log. Used on loyalty_adjust. Official Loyalty host is loyalty.yotpo.com (see LEFT).

schema.label: customer_id
schema.description: Loyalty points adjust: Yotpo customer id. loyalty_adjust.

schema.label: point_adjustment_amount
schema.description: Signed point delta for loyalty_adjust. Example: 100 or -25.

schema.label: history_title
schema.description: Loyalty history title for loyalty_adjust. Example: Workflow bonus.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: review_list | review_create | order_send | loyalty_adjust | trigger. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Utoken
configurationParameters.description: OAuth utoken minted outside StudioQuack via POST /oauth/token (app_key + store secret). Sent as query utoken on review_list (official). Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Loyalty GUID
configurationParameters.description: Yotpo Loyalty & Referrals account GUID from Loyalty settings. Sent as header X-GUID on loyalty_adjust (loyalty.yotpo.com) only; Reviews operations ignore it. Example: aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsT12. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Loyalty API Key
configurationParameters.description: Yotpo Loyalty & Referrals API key from Loyalty settings (separate from the Reviews utoken). Sent as header X-API-KEY on loyalty_adjust only. Required for loyalty_adjust. Example: loyalty-api-key-placeholder. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
